name: engramma-node
description: Node.js (N-API) binding of the Engramma memory engine

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release && node scripts/dts-append.js && node -e "require('./index.js'); console.log('addon loads')"
scripts.pretest: nice -n 19 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo build -p engramma-cli --release
scripts.pretest:electron: nice -n 19 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo build -p engramma-cli --release
